"""Offline EstimandIchE9CueExtractor extraction.

Detects advisory cues from title/abstract/methods via deterministic patterns.
Never calls the network. Distinct from IntentionToTreatCueExtractor / PrimaryEndpointCueExtractor.
Fills an Elicit / Consensus / ICH-E9(R1) estimand gap.
Optional later narrative can use GPT-5.5 / Claude Sonnet 4.6 / Gemini 3.x /
Kimi K2.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from collections.abc import Sequence
from dataclasses import dataclass

_TEXT_FIELDS = ("abstract", "title", "summary", "methods", "method", "results", "discussion")

_PATTERNS: tuple[tuple[str, re.Pattern[str]], ...] = (
    (
        "treatment_policy_estimand",
        re.compile(
            "\\btreatment[- ]policy estimand\\b|\\bICH E9\\(R1\\) treatment[- ]policy\\b",
            re.IGNORECASE,
        ),
    ),
    (
        "hypothetical_estimand",
        re.compile("\\bhypothetical estimand\\b|\\bICH E9\\(R1\\) hypothetical\\b", re.IGNORECASE),
    ),
    (
        "principal_stratum_estimand",
        re.compile("\\bprincipal stratum estimand\\b|\\bprincipal[- ]stratum\\b", re.IGNORECASE),
    ),
)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class EstimandIchE9Cue:
    """Advisory cues for one paper row."""

    paper_id: str
    cue_kind: str | None
    cues: tuple[str, ...]
    matched: tuple[str, ...]
    flagged: bool


class EstimandIchE9CueExtractor:
    """Extract offline advisory cues."""

    def extract(self, papers: Sequence[dict[str, object]]) -> tuple[EstimandIchE9Cue, ...]:
        """Return cues for ``papers``."""

        if not papers:
            return ()
        results: list[EstimandIchE9Cue] = []
        for index, paper in enumerate(papers):
            paper_id = self._resolve_id(paper, index)
            text = self._collect_text(paper)
            cues: list[str] = []
            matched: list[str] = []
            kind: str | None = None
            if text:
                for label, pattern in _PATTERNS:
                    match = pat

[project]
name = "scholar-rag-agent"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "Production-grade Agentic RAG for scientific literature with multi-hop reasoning and multi-LLM routing."
readme = "README.md"
requires-python = ">=3.11"
license = { text = "Apache-2.0" }
authors = [{ name = "Scholar RAG Agent Contributors" }]
keywords = ["agentic-rag", "graphrag", "scientific-ai", "llm-agents", "retrieval-augmented-generation"]
dependencies = [
  "defusedxml>=0.7.1",
  "fastapi>=0.111.0",
  "httpx>=0.27.0",
  "pydantic>=2.7.0",
  "pydantic-settings>=2.2.1",
  "pypdf>=4.2.0",
  "python-multipart>=0.0.9",
  "uvicorn>=0.30.0",
]

[project.optional-dependencies]
all = ["spacy>=3.7.0", "sentence-transformers>=3.0.0"]
dev = [
  "hatchling",
  "mypy>=1.10.0",
  "pytest>=8.2.0",
  "pytest-asyncio>=0.23.0",
  "pytest-cov>=5.0.0",
  "ruff>=0.5.0",
  "pillow>=10.3.0",
]

[project.scripts]
scholar-rag-api = "api.main:main"
scholar-rag-ingest = "scripts.ingest_papers:main"
scholar-rag-eval = "scripts.evaluate_retrieval:main"

[build-system]
requires = ["hatchling"]
build-backend = "hatchling.build"

[tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel]
packages = [
  "src/agent",
  "src/api",
  "src/ingestion",
  "src/llm",
  "src/retrieval",
  "src/storage",
  "src/evaluation",
  "scripts",
]

[tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel.force-include]
"src/config.py" = "config.py"

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
addopts = "-q"
asyncio_mode = "auto"
testpaths = ["tests"]

[tool.ruff]
line-length = 100
target-version = "py311"
src = ["src", "tests", "scripts"]

[tool.ruff.lint]
select = ["E", "F", "I", "B", "UP", "N", "ANN", "ASYNC", "S", "C4", "SIM", "RUF"]
ignore = ["S101"]

[tool.ruff.lint.per-file-ignores]
"tests/**/*.py" = ["S101"]
"scripts/*.py" = ["S603", "S607"]
"src/storage/graph_store.py" = ["S608"]

[tool.mypy]
python_version = "3.11"
strict = true
warn_return_any = true
warn_unused_configs = true
ignore_missing_imports = true
plugins = []
exclude = ["tests"]

# Test 2: Empty input returns empty tuple
result = extractor.extract([])

# Test 3: Detect treatment_policy_estimand cue
papers = [{'paper_id': 'test-1', 'abstract': 'We define a treatment policy estimand for this trial.'}]
result = extractor.extract(papers)
assert len(result) == 1
cue = result[0]
assert isinstance(cue, EstimandIchE9Cue)
assert cue.paper_id == 'test-1'
assert 'treatment_policy_estimand' in cue.cues
assert cue.flagged is True

# Test 4: Detect hypothetical_estimand cue
papers = [{'paper_id': 'test-2', 'abstract': 'ICH E9(R1) hypothetical estimand approach.'}]
result = extractor.extract(papers)
assert len(result) == 1
cue = result[0]
assert 'hypothetical_estimand' in cue.cues
assert cue.flagged is True

# Test 5: Detect principal_stratum_estimand cue
papers = [{'paper_id': 'test-3', 'abstract': 'principal stratum estimand analysis.'}]
result = extractor.extract(papers)
assert len(result) == 1
cue = result[0]
assert 'principal_stratum_estimand' in cue.cues
assert cue.flagged is True

# Test 6: Multiple cues in one paper
papers = [{'paper_id': 'test-4', 'abstract': 'We use treatment policy estimand and hypothetical estimand.'}]
result = extractor.extract(papers)
cue = result[0]
assert len(cue.cues) == 2
assert 'treatment_policy_estimand' in cue.cues
assert 'hypothetical_estimand' in cue.cues

# Test 7: No cues returns flagged=False
papers = [{'paper_id': 'test-5', 'abstract': 'This paper has no estimand discussion.'}]
result = extractor.extract(papers)
cue = result[0]
assert cue.flagged is False
assert cue.cues == ()

# Test 8: cue_kind is set to first matched cue kind
papers = [{'paper_id': 'test-6', 'abstract': 'treatment policy estimand and hypothetical estimand.'}]
result = extractor.extract(papers)
cue = result[0]
assert cue.cue_kind == 'treatment_policy_estimand'

print('All tests passed: EstimandIchE9CueExtractor correctly detects ICH-E9(R1) estimand cues.')
